name: Final Words

stealth.note: (trained) to hear the scratch of a quill upon paper

description: As a creature touches a hand-written letter, they witness the letter's author scribe it in the past; each pen stroke across the page carves the letter's text into the creature's flesh.
disable: DC 24 Religion (trained) to ward off the haunt or DC 25 Thievery (trained) to dispose of the letter with extreme care before the haunt can form

generalAbilities.name: Carve in Flesh
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature reads the letter

Effect The haunt deals (2d8+11) Slashing Damage damage to the triggering creature as the words are carved into its flesh (Basic DC 21 Will Saving Throw). On a failure, the creature takes 2d8 Bleed Damage.
